scope: Phoenix V3 only. V4, C ABI, embedding, SDK, multi-language host work, app-specific native DBSCAN engines, paper reproduction, and broad V2.x speedup claims are out of scope.

m7_rows_retained_as_internal_release_sur.row_scope: zero-noise four-cluster synthetic clustered3d rows from 65536 to 524288 points, repeat=5
m7_rows_retained_as_internal_release_sur.validation_basis: 4096-point CPU reference control plus large-row OptiX/Embree intra-run canonical component-signature agreement

retained_evidence_summary.speedup_range_for_approved_large_rows: 1.102x to 1.236x OptiX over same-contract Embree end-to-end

redo_interpretation.why_not_gap1_completion: The row proves a useful component_union/component-signature route, but it is not yet a productized prepared execution/session runner path shared across multiple Set-A probes.
redo_interpretation.why_keep_in_v3: The row captures a reusable component_union continuation capability, removes point-id/core-flag materialization from the component signature, and has Claude/Codex review closure under strict wording.

serious_v2x_context.interpretation: The RTDBSCAN component_union row does not override the failed broad V2.14 vs Phoenix V3 performance gate.

set_a_set_b_measurement_note.classification_for_future_all_app_scorec: RTDBSCAN is a Set-A candidate only when the shared component_union/productized execution path is the measured source of the win; materializing Embree neighbor rows remain Set-B controls.

forbidden_readings: Full DBSCAN is accelerated end to end.
RT cores accelerate full DBSCAN labels.
The old 1483.603x route-mixed all-app row is public evidence.
The RT threshold phase alone is the RTDBSCAN app speedup.
The component_union row proves broad V3-over-V2.x speedup.
The component_union row completes Gap 1 productized execution path.
next_after_closure: Keep the component_union row in the current 13-row / 9-capability internal surface.
Do not spend Phoenix time on RTDBSCAN app-specific shortcuts or native DBSCAN ABI.
If RTDBSCAN is used next, productize the shared component_union/typed-stream continuation through the prepared execution/session runner and measure it as a Set-A route.
Keep release, RTDBSCAN paper, full DBSCAN, and broad V3-over-V2 wording blocked until serious paired evidence and external review justify a new claim.

goal_level_decision_audit.decision: Close RTDBSCAN component_union for Phoenix redo as one retained row-scoped reusable capability, not as full RTDBSCAN, paper, or V3 release evidence.
goal_level_decision_audit.was_i_foolish: No. The decision keeps the reviewed repeat=5 component_union row while preserving the old no-go limits and the serious V2.x performance blocker.
goal_level_decision_audit.foolish_actions: It would be foolish to revive the old 1483.603x route-mixed row, call component_signature full DBSCAN labels, or turn a 1.102x-1.236x row-scoped range into broad V3 success.
goal_level_decision_audit.other_path: Delete RTDBSCAN from V3 because the earlier no-go was real. That would ignore the later same-contract optimization and review closure.
goal_level_decision_audit.different_path_now: Retain exactly one component_union row, document its limits, and only count future RTDBSCAN work if it lands in a shared productized continuation/runner path.
